        x=20.0,  # Centered horizontally in build zone
        y=7.25,  # Centered vertically in build zone
        width=5.0,  # Max allowed width
        height=0.1,  # Min allowed height
        angle=0,
        density=0.01  # Ensures total mass is 0.005 kg (5.0 * 0.1 * 0.01)
    )

    # Define anchor points for the beam
    floor_anchors = [
        (17.5, 0.0), (19.0, 0.0), (20.5, 0.0), (22.0, 0.0), (22.5, 0.0)
    ]
    ceiling_anchors = [
        (17.5, 9.0), (19.0, 9.0), (20.5, 9.0), (22.0, 9.0), (22.5, 9.0)
    ]

    # Attach beam to floor and ceiling to ensure stability under gravity inversion
    for anchor in floor_anchors + ceiling_anchors:
        sandbox.add_joint(beam, None, anchor, type='rigid')

    return beam
